description: This Java source file defines the ConfigXMLReader class, which reads and parses XML configuration files related to web application controllers in the OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes for handling controller configurations, events, request mappings, responses, and view mappings, along with methods for loading, caching, and retrieving configuration data.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader
classes.description: Main class for reading and parsing web app controller XML configuration files, including nested classes for configuration details, events, request mappings, responses, and view mappings.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.ControllerConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration of a web controller, including request mappings, view mappings, events, and includes.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.Event
classes.description: Represents an event within a controller, including type, path, invoke, transaction settings, and metrics.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestMap
classes.description: Defines a request mapping with URI, method, security, event, responses, and metrics.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestResponse
classes.description: Represents a response to a request, including type, value, status code, and redirect parameters.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestResponseUserMessage
classes.description: Contains user message details linked to a request response.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.ViewMap
classes.description: Defines a view mapping with page, type, content type, encoding, security options, and description.

methods.name: getEmptyNoneRequestResponse
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of an empty request response with type 'none'.

methods.name: findControllerFilesWithRequest
methods.description: Finds controller XML files that contain a specific request URI, optionally filtered by controller partial path.

methods.name: findControllerRequestUniqueForTargetType
methods.description: Finds unique controller request identifiers based on target and URL mode ('intra-app' or 'inter-app').

methods.name: getControllerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the ControllerConfig object for a given WebappInfo or URL, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getControllerConfigURL
methods.description: Gets the URL of the controller configuration XML file from the servlet context.

methods.name: loadDocument
methods.description: Loads and parses an XML document from a URL, returning the root element.
